say:1:1110401001:1.text: Hey folks, let's give 'em a big round of applause!
say:1:1110401001:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的老朋友们，请为他们送上热烈的掌声哦！

say:3:1110401002:1.text: These two kids passed the Trial of Souls?
say:3:1110401002:1.source_cn: 这两个孩子，成功通过了魂之试炼吗？

say:4:1110401003:1.text: Which clan do they represent? Ura? Ufu?
say:4:1110401003:1.source_cn: 他们代表的新氏族叫什么来着？乌拉？乌呼？

say:7:1110401004:1.text: Did you hear that, Soren? They are talking about us!
say:7:1110401004:1.source_cn: 听到了吗， 索恩？有人在议论我们呢！

say:9:1110401005:1.text: Can't they at least get our clan's name right first?
say:9:1110401005:1.source_cn: 议论我们之前，就不能先把乌尔氏族的名字叫对吗？

say:11:1110401006:1.text: No need to rush, young warriors of the Uru Clan. A true hero's name will stick eventually.
say:11:1110401006:1.source_cn: 何必操之过急，乌尔氏族的年轻勇者？只要是英雄，终将名满天下。

say:12:1110401007:1.text: Even the strongest of them all, Brutus, was called "Bruce" more than once before he made it big...
say:12:1110401007:1.source_cn: 即使强如布鲁特斯，成为战神前，也曾有人把他的名字错喊成...

say:13:1110401008:1.text: Enough about the past! What matters now is that you've aced the <style="highlight">Trial of Souls</style>. Congratulations!
say:13:1110401008:1.source_cn: 啊，不重要了，都是些往事！现在最重要的是，你们通过了<...

say:14:1110401009:1.text: But it's not yet time to celebrate. Your next challenge, the <style="highlight">Trial of Wisdom</style>, awaits at a special spot at the foot of Mars Peak!
say:14:1110401009:1.source_cn: 不过，可别高兴太久哦！第三道试炼<style=high...

say:16:1110401011:1.text: That's right! We're one step closer to Mars Peak!
say:16:1110401011:1.source_cn: 没错！我们距离战神峰顶，又近了一步！

say:17:1110401012:1.text: As I said earlier, it's not yet time to celebrate. Your third test is a challenging one; I'll meet you at the camp by Mars Peak!
say:17:1110401012:1.source_cn: 别高兴得太早哦！第三道试炼并不简单，我们先在战神峰山脚...

say:18:1110401013:1.source_cn: 所以曼卡拉建议你们，现在就出发！

say:19:1110401014:1.text: Got it! Hang on... If memory serves, to reach Mars Peak, we have to go through...
say:19:1110401014:1.source_cn: 没问题！但是，等等……从这里去战神峰的路，我没记错的话...

choice_prompt:20:1110401014.text: Got it! Hang on... If memory serves, to reach Mars Peak, we have to go through...
choice_prompt:20:1110401014.source_cn: 没问题！但是，等等……从这里去战神峰的路，我没记错的话，要通过——

say:21:1110401015:1.text: I hope I'm wrong... Let's talk to the guard at the arena.
say:21:1110401015:1.source_cn: 希望是我记错了……我们先问问武斗场的守卫吧。
say:21:1110401015:1.male: I hope I'm wrong... Let's talk to the guard at the arena.
say:21:1110401015:1.female: I hope I'm wrong... Let's talk to the guard at the arena.

choice:20:0:1.text: Got a problem with the route?
choice:20:0:1.male: Got a problem with the route?
choice:20:0:1.female: Got a problem with the route?

say:0:1110401101:0.text: I can't believe this, Soren. We passed the second trial!
say:0:1110401101:0.source_cn: 简直像做梦一样！索恩，我们通过了第二道试炼！

say:1:1110401102:0.text: Yeah, it was a bit more troublesome than expected.
say:1:1110401102:0.source_cn: 嗯，比想象中麻烦了一点。

say:2:1110401103:0.text: A bit? Come on, no need to fake your cool in front of me!
say:2:1110401103:0.source_cn: 只是麻烦一点吗？！这个时候，就不要装深沉了吧？

say:3:1110401104:0.text: Let's get going. The third challenge is awaiting us.
say:3:1110401104:0.source_cn: 快回去吧，还有第三道试炼呢。

say:1:1110402001:1.text: Sir, we'd like to know the fastest way to Mars Peak.
say:1:1110402001:1.source_cn: 守卫大哥，我们想打听通往战神峰的近路……

say:3:1110402002:1.text: The quickest route is through the back gate of the Sunseek Arena.
say:3:1110402002:1.source_cn: 最近的路，就是从这道残阳武斗场的后门穿过。

choice_prompt:4:1110402002.text: The quickest route is through the back gate of the Sunseek Arena.
choice_prompt:4:1110402002.source_cn: 最近的路，就是从这道残阳武斗场的后门穿过。

say:5:1110402003:1.text: I'm sorry, but that's not possible. The Warsong Festival is a major event for the Maulers, and for safety reasons...
say:5:1110402003:1.source_cn: 抱歉，请诸位理解。战歌节是蛮血的盛事，为了避免治安问题……

say:6:1110402004:1.text: Only those with an official permit can pass through before the event begins.
say:6:1110402004:1.source_cn: 正式开始前，这里只能经由持有文书的人士通行。

say:7:1110402005:1.text: How can we obtain a permit?
say:7:1110402005:1.source_cn: 我们怎么能拿到文书呢？

say:8:1110402006:1.text: It's not a simple process. It involves verification and a background check.
say:8:1110402006:1.source_cn: 手续很麻烦，而且需要审核资格和验证身份。

say:10:1110402007:1.text: What? But we don't have time.
say:10:1110402007:1.source_cn: 什么？可我们必须赶过去，不能延误时间。

say:11:1110402008:1.text: In that case, you'll need to find another way.
say:11:1110402008:1.source_cn: 那恐怕你们只能另想办法了。

say:12:1110402009:1.text: Please, sir, we're desperate! Could you perhaps turn a blind eye during your lunch break?
say:12:1110402009:1.source_cn: 那个那个，守卫大哥，打个商量！您在吃午餐的时候，或许可...

say:13:1110402010:1.text: What's this? Are you questioning the honor of a Mauler warrior?
say:13:1110402010:1.source_cn: 这是什么意思？你是在质疑一个蛮血战士的尊严吗？

say:14:1110402011:0.text: ...Forgive us, but we really need to get through for our third trial! Please, can you help us?
say:14:1110402011:0.source_cn: ……抱歉，但我们真的很想快点赶过去！我们需要参加第三道试炼！

say:15:1110402012:1.text: So, you're participants? While you still can't use this gate, I know another route to reach the camp on time.
say:15:1110402012:1.source_cn: 参加试炼的勇士吗？虽然还是不能让你们通过，但是你们经过...

choice_prompt:16:1110402012.text: So, you're participants? While you still can't use this gate, I know another route to reach the camp on time.
choice_prompt:16:1110402012.source_cn: 参加试炼的勇士吗？虽然还是不能让你们通过，但是你们经过另一条路，也能按时抵达。

say:17:1110402013:1.source_cn: 离开武斗场后，向东南方向进发。

say:18:1110402014:1.text: That way? But that's the Grimmaw Clan's territory!
say:18:1110402014:1.source_cn: 那个方向？那里是——黑嚎氏族的领地！

say:19:1110402015:1.text: Not on good terms with the Grimmaw Clan? That's too bad. Unfortunately, it seems that's your only option.
say:19:1110402015:1.source_cn: 你们有过节？那还真倒霉。但能让你们尽快过去的，只有那条路了。

say:0:1110403001:0.text: I guess that's the only way.
say:0:1110403001:0.source_cn: 没办法，只能走这条路了。

say:1:1110403002:0.text: Well... I'm definitely not scared of them!
say:1:1110403002:0.source_cn: 那些蛮横卑劣的家伙……我不怕他们。

say:2:1110403003:0.text: Let's try to pass through their territory without conflict.
say:2:1110403003:0.source_cn: 小心谨慎，尽量不要发生冲突地经过那里吧。
say:2:1110403003:0.male: Let's try to pass through their territory without conflict.
say:2:1110403003:0.female: Let's try to pass through their territory without conflict.

say:1:1110405001:0.text: Who are you? Where do you come from, and where are you headed?
say:1:1110405001:0.source_cn: 站住。你们是谁？哪儿来的？要去哪儿？

choice_prompt:2:1110405001.text: Who are you? Where do you come from, and where are you headed?
choice_prompt:2:1110405001.source_cn: 站住。你们是谁？哪儿来的？要去哪儿？

say:3:1110405002:0.text: Sunseek Arena? It's nearly time for the Warsong Festival. Are you competitors this year?
say:3:1110405002:0.source_cn: 残阳武斗场？战歌节要开始了，你们难道是参赛的勇士？

say:4:1110405003:0.text: Yes, we're taking part in this year's Warsong Festival.
say:4:1110405003:0.source_cn: ……是的，我们是战歌节的参赛者。

say:6:1110405006:1.text: Interesting. But word has it you two still have challenges to complete?
say:6:1110405006:1.source_cn: 我怎么听说你们还在试炼，没有获得承认呢？

say:7:1110405007:0.source_cn: 我们一定会获得参赛资格。

say:9:1110405008:0.text: That's very bold of you! Wait a second. You look familiar... You remind me of that worthless Mauler we cast out...
say:9:1110405008:0.source_cn: 好大的口气！不过，你小子好像有点眼熟。和我们族内被抛弃...

say:10:1110405009:0.text: That's right! The weakling born with barely any fur...
say:10:1110405009:0.source_cn: 没错，生下来光秃秃的，浑身没几根熊毛——

say:14:1110405012:1.text: We're not here to reminisce. Just passing through.
say:14:1110405012:1.source_cn: ……呼，你们没必要跟我叙旧。我们只想借个路，仅此而已。

say:15:1110405013:0.text: Not happening. That weakling's grown into a little fibber. Claiming to be participants in this year's Warsong Festival?
say:15:1110405013:0.source_cn: 不，不行。你不老实。生下来就是弱者，长到现在块头也不大...

say:17:1110405014:0.text: Yeah, a suspicious character like you needs a thorough interrogation. Come with us!
say:17:1110405014:0.source_cn: 没错，对撒谎的可疑人士，必须带走好好盘查。跟我们走！

say:18:1110405015:0.text: Enough nonsense. You know I'm speaking the truth. Why else would your rude buddies harass our clan?
say:18:1110405015:0.source_cn: 别开玩笑了，你们明明什么都知道！不然，怎么会派人去骚扰...

say:19:1110405016:0.text: You'll need a better excuse to hold us here. Do you think we're afraid of you?
say:19:1110405016:0.source_cn: 现在竟然想用这种差劲借口扣下我们——是觉得我们会怕吗？

say:20:1110405017:0.text: Soren, calm down! We don't want to fight them on their territory!
say:20:1110405017:0.source_cn: 索恩，别冲动！这里是他们的领地，我们不能轻举妄动！

say:21:1110405018:0.text: We can't afford to miss the trial! Remember your promise to Pops?
say:21:1110405018:0.source_cn: 现在把事情闹大，我们可能会错过试炼的！想想和老爹的约定吧！

say:24:1110405020:0.text: Good pups! Time to pay a visit to our main camp.
say:24:1110405020:0.source_cn: 乖乖得多好啊，省了我们多少事！走，带这些人去主营！

say:26:1110405004:0.text: Mars Peak? That's reserved for Warsong Festival warriors only.
say:26:1110405004:0.source_cn: 战神峰？除了战歌节的勇士们，没人能去战神峰。
say:26:1110405004:0.male: Mars Peak? That's reserved for Warsong Festival warriors only.
say:26:1110405004:0.female: Mars Peak? That's reserved for Warsong Festival warriors only.

say:27:1110405005:0.text: Alsa and I are competing in the Warsong Festival.
say:27:1110405005:0.source_cn: ……就像你说的，我和阿尔萨是战歌节的参赛者。

choice:2:1:2.text: We need to head to Mars Peak.
choice:2:1:2.male: We need to head to Mars Peak.
choice:2:1:2.female: We need to head to Mars Peak.

narration:0:1110405101:0.text: Everyone is being taken to the Grimmaw Camp.
narration:0:1110405101:0.source_cn: 众人被带到了黑嚎氏族大本营内

say:1:1110406001:1.text: Keep your guard up. This is their territory.
say:1:1110406001:1.source_cn: 小心点。这里就是他们的老巢。

say:2:1110406002:1.text: Alsa, if things turn sour, stay behind me—
say:2:1110406002:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨，如果他们发难，就躲进我身后——

say:4:1110406003:1.text: Soren, welcome back! And Alsa! The tales of you two Mauler warriors have traveled far and wide across the desert!
say:4:1110406003:1.source_cn: 索恩，欢迎回归！还有阿尔萨！两位蛮血勇士的英名已经传遍...

choice_prompt:6:1110406003.text: Soren, welcome back! And Alsa! The tales of you two Mauler warriors have traveled far and wide across the desert!
choice_prompt:6:1110406003.source_cn: 索恩，欢迎回归！还有阿尔萨！两位蛮血勇士的英名已经传遍了沙漠！

say:7:1110406004:1.text: What's happening? We didn't expect such a warm reception after being dragged here by force...
say:7:1110406004:1.source_cn: 怎么回事？我们被押送过来，实在没想到还能享受这种待遇……

say:9:1110406006:1.text: Idiots! What did I tell you? I said to INVITE them!
say:9:1110406006:1.source_cn: ——你们这两个笨蛋，完全搞错了！我说的是“请”！

say:10:1110406007:1.text: How dare you lay a hand on two promising young warriors, especially Soren?
say:10:1110406007:1.source_cn: 对这样两位年少有为的著名勇者——尤其是索恩，怎能如此粗暴？

say:12:1110406008:0.text: I apologize, chief! It was a misunderstanding... I'm prepared to accept my punishment!
say:12:1110406008:0.source_cn: 对不起，大哥，我们错了。我下去自己领罚！

say:14:1110406009:1.text: Soren, please forgive us. The entire clan is thrilled about your return.
say:14:1110406009:1.source_cn: 索恩，真抱歉！其实你回到家来，整个氏族都很高兴。

say:15:1110406010:1.text: Return? What are you talking about?

say:16:1110406011:1.text: Um... Orson is waiting for you. He'll explain everything.
say:16:1110406011:1.source_cn: 这……奥格老大要亲自见你，到时候你们可以细说。

say:0:1110407001:0.text: Soren, it's great to have you back!

say:1:1110407002:0.text: You bring honor to the Grimmaw Clan!

say:2:1110407003:0.text: May you bring even more glory to the clan!
say:2:1110407003:0.source_cn: 让他代表咱们黑嚎赢得荣耀吧！

say:3:1110407004:0.text: What a remarkable young warrior! And a true Grimmaw warrior!
say:3:1110407004:0.source_cn: 年轻的勇士，黑嚎的勇士！

say:0:1110408001:0.text: Orson... Why does he want to see us?

say:1:1110408002:0.text: ...I don't think it's for anything good. We need to leave as soon as we can.
say:1:1110408002:0.source_cn: ……总归不是什么好事，早点找机会离开吧。

say:1:1110410001:1.text: I was told that you passed the <style="highlight">Trial of Blood</style> and the <style="highlight">Trial of Souls</style> on your first attempt.
say:1:1110410001:1.source_cn: 有人告诉我，你初次参赛，就通过了<style=high...

say:2:1110410002:1.text: Even Brutus himself praised you! The Grimmaw Clan respects strength, and you've proven yours.
say:2:1110410002:1.source_cn: 连布鲁特斯都称赞了你，黑嚎氏族厌弃的只是弱者。而你，已...

say:3:1110410003:1.text: As chief of the Grimmaw Clan, I, Orson, extend an invitation to you...
say:3:1110410003:1.source_cn: 现在，我奥格作为黑嚎氏族的首领，向你发出邀请——

say:5:1110410004:1.text: An invitation... to return to the clan?

say:6:1110410005:1.text: A true warrior aligns with the strong—I understand this better than anyone.
say:6:1110410005:1.source_cn: 强者，该与强者为伍。我比任何人都理解这一点。

say:7:1110410006:1.text: <style="highlight">"Why is the Grimmaw Clan so strong?"</style> That's a question our defeated foes often ponder...

say:9:1110410008:1.text: Soren, you're too young to grasp... All Maulers are flesh and bone. Why are some stronger than others?
say:9:1110410008:1.source_cn: 索恩，你还年轻，不懂得……蛮血都是血肉之躯，为何有人弱...

say:10:1110410009:1.text: The answer's simple. The strong are willing to sacrifice everything for power.
say:10:1110410009:1.source_cn: 答案很简单。强者为了追逐力量，可以抛弃一切。

say:11:1110410010:1.text: And the weak? They're foolish and greedy, unwilling to let go of anything and hoping to cling to it all.
say:11:1110410010:1.source_cn: 弱者则愚蠢又贪婪，他们什么都想……“保护”，想要抓在手心。

say:14:1110410012:1.text: You're Alsa, aren't you? You can't seriously be asking that—it's utterly wrong! A weak soul's promise means nothing.
say:14:1110410012:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨，是吗？大错特错，弱者虚伪的诺言没有意义。

say:15:1110410013:1.text: In this harsh, unforgiving land, those with feeble bodies and feeble minds are destined to be at a disadvantage.
say:15:1110410013:1.source_cn: 在这片残酷的贫瘠之地，脆弱的身体和虚弱的意志注定处于劣势。

say:16:1110410014:1.text: Come back, Soren. You have my word. The Grimmaw Clan has no place for the weak or vulnerable.
say:16:1110410014:1.source_cn: 回归氏族吧，索恩。我向你保证，黑嚎氏族不是那种软弱的地方。

say:17:1110410015:1.text: Everyone here is strong, and strength is our currency. Your fists will get you everything you desire.
say:17:1110410015:1.source_cn: 这里强者林立，只靠力量说话。只要你足够强，便能无所顾忌。

say:19:1110410017:1.text: ...Hmph! It's one thing for a mighty warrior to have some pride, but if you're still holding a grudge from your childhood, that's just petty and small-minded.
say:19:1110410017:1.source_cn: ……哼，强者的矜持，是吗？但你如此记恨当年的事，这就不...

say:20:1110410018:1.text: The Grimmaw Clan wouldn't exist if we showed pity to the weak. When you're in my position, you'll—
say:20:1110410018:1.source_cn: 如果容忍软弱，黑嚎氏族不会走到今天。如果有一天，你处在...

say:21:1110410019:1.text: Enough, Orson. That will never happen.
say:21:1110410019:1.source_cn: 别妄想了，奥格。不会有那一天的。

say:22:1110410020:1.text: I've found my family. Returning to the Grimmaw Clan? Ugh, the thought makes me sick...
say:22:1110410020:1.source_cn: 我有我自己的氏族。要做黑嚎的族人？这件事只是想想，就让...

say:23:1110410021:1.text: Your family? You're one of us! Strength and talent run in your blood, and blood doesn't lie!
say:23:1110410021:1.source_cn: 你自己的氏族？你属于黑嚎！你的战斗天分传承自黑嚎的血脉...

say:24:1110410022:1.text: Join us, or I'm afraid this will be the end of you!
say:24:1110410022:1.source_cn: 要是你不肯回头——你们就永远都别想离开这里一步！

say:0:1110412001:0.text: The chief is injured! Get them!
say:0:1110412001:0.source_cn: 他们伤了奥格老大！快上，别让他们逃了！

say:1:1110412002:0.text: After them! For the honor of the Grimmaw Clan!
say:1:1110412002:0.source_cn: 抓住他们！别让黑嚎之名蒙羞！

say:0:1110413001:0.text: Soren, you're not slipping away today!

say:1:1110413002:0.text: Surround them! Let's show these urchins what we're made of!
say:1:1110413002:0.source_cn: 围住他们！让他们看看黑嚎的厉害！

say:0:1110414001:0.text: Are we even going the right way?

say:1:1110414002:0.text: I haven't got a clue. How would I know?... Wait! Look! A gate!
say:1:1110414002:0.source_cn: 你问我？我是乱跑的，我怎么可能知道这里的路啊——看！是大门

say:0:1110415001:0.source_cn: 糟了，门关着！这里是死路！

say:1:1110415002:0.text: No turning back now... Let's search around for another way out.
say:1:1110415002:0.source_cn: 现在回头来不及了……在附近找找破门的方法吧。
say:1:1110415002:0.male: No turning back now... Let's search around for another way out.
say:1:1110415002:0.female: No turning back now... Let's search around for another way out.

say:0:1110416001:0.source_cn: 主人！附近有炸药的味道！

say:1:1110416002:0.text: You're the best, Chippy! Lead the way.
say:1:1110416002:0.source_cn: 满满真棒，带我们过去找找。
say:1:1110416002:0.male: You're the best, Chippy! Lead the way.
say:1:1110416002:0.female: You're the best, Chippy! Lead the way.

say:0:1110417001:0.text: Let's try to blast open the gate.
say:0:1110417001:0.male: Let's try to blast open the gate.
say:0:1110417001:0.female: Let's try to blast open the gate.

say:0:1110418001:0.source_cn: 亏你们能想到这个主意……

say:1:1110418002:0.text: Hurry. We've got no time to waste.
say:1:1110418002:0.source_cn: 快走吧，这里不是久留之地。
say:1:1110418002:0.male: Hurry. We've got no time to waste.
say:1:1110418002:0.female: Hurry. We've got no time to waste.

say:0:1110419001:0.text: Over there! A checkpoint! If we can get through there, we're safe!
say:0:1110419001:0.source_cn: 前面——是哨卡！只要通过那里，应该就能离开了！

say:1:1110419002:0.text: We've got intruders trying to break through!

say:1:1110420001:1.text: You three injured our chief. You're not getting through here.
say:1:1110420001:1.source_cn: 诸位打伤了我们的族长，恕我不能让你们通过。

say:3:1110420002:1.text: Orson brought it on himself. He picked the fight and lost. You blaming us?
say:3:1110420002:1.source_cn: 奥格是咎由自取。是他主动发难，战败负伤，这难道还能怪我们？

say:4:1110420003:1.text: You must be Soren. I should have known.
say:4:1110420003:1.source_cn: 看来你就是索恩。我早该注意到的。

say:5:1110420004:1.text: I'm sure you've got your reasons, but they don't fly with the Grimmaw Clan under my brother's leadership.
say:5:1110420004:1.source_cn: 我相信你有自己的道理，但道理在我哥哥率领的黑嚎是行不通的。

choice_prompt:6:1110420004.text: I'm sure you've got your reasons, but they don't fly with the Grimmaw Clan under my brother's leadership.
choice_prompt:6:1110420004.source_cn: 我相信你有自己的道理，但道理在我哥哥率领的黑嚎是行不通的。

say:7:1110420006:1.text: Yes, the same blood flows through our veins.
say:7:1110420006:1.source_cn: 伟大的血脉将我们连接在一起。
say:7:1110420006:1.male: Yes, the same blood flows through our veins.
say:7:1110420006:1.female: Yes, the same blood flows through our veins.

say:9:1110420007:1.text: But you're actually talking to us instead of throwing punches for no reason...
say:9:1110420007:1.source_cn: 但是，你能跟我们对话，而不是直接战斗……

say:10:1110420008:1.text: Do you... not fully agree with what Orson's doing?
say:10:1110420008:1.source_cn: 你，并不完全认同奥格的想法吧？

say:11:1110420009:1.text: Speak for yourself. Orson has my full support as his brother and fellow clansman.
say:11:1110420009:1.source_cn: 我从没说过那样的话。我忠于奥格——作为血亲，也作为族人。

say:12:1110420010:1.text: Under his orders, I'm blocking your path. But at the same time...
say:12:1110420010:1.source_cn: 他命令我拦住你们，现在我拦住了。但同时——

say:13:1110420011:1.text: I'm a fighter myself. A true Grimmaw warrior respects other fighters.
say:13:1110420011:1.source_cn: 我也是一名战士。真正的黑嚎战士，面对勇士，绝不会无动于衷。

say:14:1110420012:1.text: Let's battle. You can only pass if you defeat me!
say:14:1110420012:1.source_cn: 那么，战斗吧。如果你们能堂堂正正赢了我，我就放你们走！

say:16:1110420005:1.text: We really are brothers, part of the same Grimmaw family.
say:16:1110420005:1.source_cn: 我们确实是黑嚎一脉相承的亲兄弟。
say:16:1110420005:1.male: We really are brothers, part of the same Grimmaw family.
say:16:1110420005:1.female: We really are brothers, part of the same Grimmaw family.

choice:6:1:2.text: You don't look alike at all.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你和奥格长得似乎不太像
choice:6:1:2.male: You don't look alike at all.
choice:6:1:2.female: You don't look alike at all.

say:0:1110422001:0.text: I'll keep my word. Leave now, before the others arrive.
say:0:1110422001:0.source_cn: 我会信守诺言，其他人赶来之前，快些离开吧。

say:1:1110422002:0.text: Are you serious? What about you?
say:1:1110422002:0.source_cn: 真的放我们走？那你怎么跟奥格交待？

say:2:1110422003:0.text: Don't worry. Orson isn't heartless. He won't be too harsh on his own brother.
say:2:1110422003:0.source_cn: 放心。奥格并非残暴之人，也不会对他的亲弟弟下手太狠。

say:0:1110423001:0.text: I didn't expect to find a good man in your Grimmaw Clan...
say:0:1110423001:0.source_cn: 没想到，你们黑嚎氏族也有好人啊……

say:1:1110423002:0.source_cn: 你再敢说“你们黑嚎氏族”试试！

say:2:1110423003:0.text: Relax, I was just joking! Soren's the protector of our Uru Clan. We can't do without you!
say:2:1110423003:0.source_cn: 别生气！开玩笑！索恩是我们乌尔氏族的守护者，绝不能失去！

say:0:1110425001:0.text: I thought we'd be stuck in Grimmaw territory... Thank goodness we made it out!
say:0:1110425001:0.source_cn: 差点以为要被留在黑嚎的地盘上了……幸好幸好，赶上了！

say:1:1110425002:0.text: Dear friends, let's give a warm welcome to the two young warriors from the Uru Clan!
say:1:1110425002:0.source_cn: 曼卡拉的老朋友们，让我们欢迎乌尔氏族两位年轻勇士抵达战...

say:1:1110426001:0.source_cn: 曼卡拉，我们及时赶来啦！

say:2:1110426002:1.text: Is it time for our third trial?
say:2:1110426002:1.source_cn: 第三项试炼，现在开始吗？

say:3:1110426003:1.text: Not yet. We're waiting for one more challenger.
say:3:1110426003:1.source_cn: 目前还有时间，而且有一位挑战者尚未到达，所以现在试炼还...

say:4:1110426004:1.text: Is that so? Alsa, let's find a spot to rest—
say:4:1110426004:1.source_cn: 是吗？那阿尔萨，我们找个地方休息——

say:5:1110426005:1.text: Hold on! Just a moment, please. I have a favor to ask.
say:5:1110426005:1.source_cn: 嘘！稍等我一会，曼卡拉有件事想拜托你们！

choice_prompt:6:1110426005.text: Hold on! Just a moment, please. I have a favor to ask.
choice_prompt:6:1110426005.source_cn: 嘘！稍等我一会，曼卡拉有件事想拜托你们！

say:7:1110426006:1.text: It's not a big deal, just a bit tricky. I need some fresh faces here to assist.
say:7:1110426006:1.source_cn: 有件棘手的小事，我需要第一次来营地的人帮忙。
say:7:1110426006:1.male: It's not a big deal, just a bit tricky. I need some fresh faces here to assist.
say:7:1110426006:1.female: It's not a big deal, just a bit tricky. I need some fresh faces here to assist.

say:8:1110426008:1.text: Listen. There's a Mauler peddling stamina-boosting potions to contestants near the camp. The potions themselves aren't illegal, but it's against the rules to use them in the festival!
say:8:1110426008:1.source_cn: 事情是这样的，营地附近，有蛮血在向参赛者兜售提升比赛表...

say:9:1110426009:1.text: He's quite cunning. We've tried to catch him a few times but failed. Alsa, Soren, I had an idea...
say:9:1110426009:1.source_cn: 但那人十分狡猾，我们尝试了几次都没有抓到他！阿尔萨，索...

say:10:1110426010:1.text: If the two of you pretend to be interested in them, he might reveal himself!
say:10:1110426010:1.source_cn: 如果你们两个假装成对非法药剂感兴趣的参赛者，说不定就能...

choice_prompt:11:1110426010.text: If the two of you pretend to be interested in them, he might reveal himself!
choice_prompt:11:1110426010.source_cn: 如果你们两个假装成对非法药剂感兴趣的参赛者，说不定就能把那家伙抓出来！

say:12:1110426011:1.text: We need to let our cunning target make the first move!
say:12:1110426011:1.source_cn: 对付狡猾的对象，就得要骗他主动出击才行！
say:12:1110426011:1.male: We need to let our cunning target make the first move!
say:12:1110426011:1.female: We need to let our cunning target make the first move!

say:13:1110426012:1.text: As the announcer of the festival, I simply can't rest when I see someone circumventing the rules!
say:13:1110426012:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉只是担心有参赛者用了之后出岔子，这种事故最无趣了...
say:13:1110426012:1.male: As the announcer of the festival, I simply can't rest when I see someone circumventing the rules!
say:13:1110426012:1.female: As the announcer of the festival, I simply can't rest when I see someone circumventing the rules!

say:14:1110426013:1.text: You don't think you can do it yourself?

say:15:1110426015:1.text: Um... Mikola, I really want to help, but I'm not cut out for this. And as for Soren...
say:15:1110426015:1.source_cn: 呃……曼卡拉，我很想帮你。可是我不知道怎么表演，索恩——

say:16:1110426016:1.text: He's not the right fit for this job! Clumsy and slow, he's sure to mess up the plan!
say:16:1110426016:1.source_cn: 就更不可能了！这家伙又闷又迟钝，绝对会露馅的！

say:17:1110426017:1.text: Don't worry about me! You were never good at keeping secrets when we were kids.
say:17:1110426017:1.source_cn: 我才不会。从小藏不住心事，把什么都挂在脸上，你这样骗得...

say:18:1110426018:1.text: Huh? You two are Warsong Festival warriors! Don't you trust each other? Well, I trust you completely!
say:18:1110426018:1.source_cn: 唔？堂堂战歌节勇士，都对自己这么没信心？曼卡拉可是对你...

say:19:1110426019:1.text: You've got this, just because I said so! Follow me. This way!
say:19:1110426019:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉说你们可以，你们就可以！跟我走！这边这边！

choice:11:0:1.text: This... sounds like it'll go well.
choice:11:0:1.male: This... sounds like it'll go well.
choice:11:0:1.female: This... sounds like it'll go well.

say:21:1110426014:1.text: Of course. I've got everything planned out!
say:21:1110426014:1.source_cn: 没问题的，我已经想好了计划！
say:21:1110426014:1.male: Of course. I've got everything planned out!
say:21:1110426014:1.female: Of course. I've got everything planned out!

choice:11:1:2.text: Don't doubt us! You have a plan?
choice:11:1:2.male: Don't doubt us! You have a plan?
choice:11:1:2.female: Don't doubt us! You have a plan?

say:22:1110426007:1.text: No, it has to be someone new here.
say:22:1110426007:1.source_cn: 不行，因为这件事需要生面孔来帮忙。
say:22:1110426007:1.male: No, it has to be someone new here.
say:22:1110426007:1.female: No, it has to be someone new here.

say:0:1110427001:0.text: Right here. I'll leave you where the guy was spotted. Good luck!
say:0:1110427001:0.source_cn: 就是这里了！药剂师出现的区域，我们先撤……

say:1:1110429001:1.text: Ugh... The final trial will begin soon. I'm not sure if I can handle this!
say:1:1110429001:1.source_cn: 唉，最后的试炼马上就要开始了，我这个心，七上八下，真是没底！

say:2:1110429002:1.text: My body's aching so much! I'm exhausted and drained!
say:2:1110429002:1.source_cn: 我、我觉得肌肉酸痛，消耗过度，有些无力。

say:3:1110429003:1.text: Oh, if only there was a magic potion to give me an instant stamina boost! Even if it had side effects!
say:3:1110429003:1.source_cn: 哎！要是能有什么神奇的药水，喝下去就能增强体力该多好！...

say:4:1110429004:1.text: But we've never been here before. Where would we find such a miraculous item?
say:4:1110429004:1.source_cn: 可是我们初来乍到，去哪里找这样的药水呢……

choice_prompt:6:1110429004.text: But we've never been here before. Where would we find such a miraculous item?
choice_prompt:6:1110429004.source_cn: 可是我们初来乍到，去哪里找这样的药水呢……

say:8:1110429005:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I didn't think Alsa and Soren would be great actors, but I didn't expect...
say:8:1110429005:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I didn't think Alsa and Soren would be great actors, but I didn't expect...
say:8:1110429005:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I didn't think Alsa and Soren would be great actors, but I didn't expect...

say:10:1110429006:1.text: ...them to be this terrible! Even Chippy wouldn't fall for it.
say:10:1110429006:1.source_cn: 竟然会差到这个地步！即使是满满，也不会上当的！
say:10:1110429006:1.male: ...them to be this terrible! Even Chippy wouldn't fall for it.
say:10:1110429006:1.female: ...them to be this terrible! Even Chippy wouldn't fall for it.

say:13:1110429008:0.text: Hey there! You two are festival competitors, right? I'm Smokey. Heard you were on the hunt for some stamina-boosting goodies?
say:13:1110429008:0.source_cn: 哎呀呀，两位是参赛者？阿熏碰巧听了一耳朵！莫非是在寻找...

say:15:1110429009:0.text: That's right! I heard there was a rulebreakin—
say:15:1110429009:0.source_cn: 没错没错！听说这附近有个蛮血——唔唔！

say:16:1110429010:0.text: Ahem! We are in urgent need of such an item. Can you help us?
say:16:1110429010:0.source_cn: 咳咳咳！我们急需那种药，你知道什么地方能搞到吗？

say:17:1110429011:0.text: I've got just what you need! It's super effective! Take one and you'll be energized enough to face Brutus, the god of war!
say:17:1110429011:0.source_cn: 唔，那种药我也知道。效果可真是神了！喝下去力量暴涨，面...

say:19:1110429013:0.text: Interested? It's a lifesaver for young warriors like yourselves! Lucky you stumbled upon me!
say:19:1110429013:0.source_cn: 是不是很令人动心？像您这样的年轻勇士，更是需要这种药剂...

say:20:1110429014:1.text: I happen to have some, but it's a bit pricey... However, trust me, it's worth it. Plus, I'll give you a special discount if you buy two!
say:20:1110429014:1.source_cn: 咱们手头就有一些。当然，贵是贵了点……不过绝对物超所值...

say:25:1110429016:1.text: It's a shame it's so expensive. Our clan...
say:25:1110429016:1.source_cn: 很贵吗？还是算了吧，我们的氏族……

say:26:1110429017:1.text: Wait, warriors! You won't find this anywhere else. Only I know the recipe!
say:26:1110429017:1.source_cn: 留步，勇士！我保证别人家没有这样的药，这是我阿熏的独家配方！

say:28:1110429018:1.text: Are you the only one selling it here?
say:28:1110429018:1.source_cn: 你是说，这附近只有你在卖药？

say:29:1110429019:1.text: Exactly! Don't let my appearance fool you. I'm the only potion master in the Ashen Wastes!
say:29:1110429019:1.source_cn: 没错！别看我这样，配药的手艺可是荒角沙漠独一份！

say:30:1110429020:1.text: You must be the one providing potions to the contestants. Come with us!
say:30:1110429020:1.source_cn: 果然你就是那个活动在附近的非法药贩。走吧，曼卡拉有事找你。

say:32:1110429021:1.text: Smokey, is it? Hold up. We need to have a chat.
say:32:1110429021:1.source_cn: 阿熏是吧？站住，跟曼卡拉聊聊吧！

say:33:1110429022:1.text: Ah! Are you here to arrest me? I... gotta run!
say:33:1110429022:1.source_cn: 啊啊！是来抓我的吗！我……先走一步！

say:36:1110429007:1.text: Er... I didn't expect them to be THIS bad at acting. Perhaps I shouldn't have insisted...
say:36:1110429007:1.source_cn: 这……曼卡拉也没想到效果这么惨烈！果然我是有点强人所难了吧？
say:36:1110429007:1.male: Er... I didn't expect them to be THIS bad at acting. Perhaps I shouldn't have insisted...
say:36:1110429007:1.female: Er... I didn't expect them to be THIS bad at acting. Perhaps I shouldn't have insisted...

say:1:1110432001:1.text: Can't we just talk? Why do we have to resort to violence? It's so uncalled for!
say:1:1110432001:1.source_cn: 有话不能好好说吗？一上来就是打人！太粗暴了！

say:5:1110432003:1.text: Sure. Let's talk. About you selling those potions and tempting the contestants!
say:5:1110432003:1.source_cn: 行啊，好好说说你兜售非法药剂的事吧。这次可别想逃！

say:6:1110432004:1.text: Potions? You mean these energy drinks? To be honest, they're just awful-tasting beverages.
say:6:1110432004:1.source_cn: 非法药剂？您说的是这些瓶装饮品吗？这些只是单纯难喝的饮料！

choice_prompt:7:1110432004.text: Potions? You mean these energy drinks? To be honest, they're just awful-tasting beverages.
choice_prompt:7:1110432004.source_cn: 非法药剂？您说的是这些瓶装饮品吗？这些只是单纯难喝的饮料！

say:8:1110432005:1.text: Um... Well... Some salespeople like me tend to be a bit dramatic.
say:8:1110432005:1.source_cn: 这个……这个……推销药剂时，总需要一些夸张的说法。
say:8:1110432005:1.male: Um... Well... Some salespeople like me tend to be a bit dramatic.
say:8:1110432005:1.female: Um... Well... Some salespeople like me tend to be a bit dramatic.

say:9:1110432006:1.text: I do know the recipe for this super stamina booster, but the ingredients are incredibly rare and difficult to obtain.
say:9:1110432006:1.source_cn: 虽说那种“会让体力暴涨”的药，我是了解一些配方……但那...
say:9:1110432006:1.male: I do know the recipe for this super stamina booster, but the ingredients are incredibly rare and difficult to obtain.
say:9:1110432006:1.female: I do know the recipe for this super stamina booster, but the ingredients are incredibly rare and difficult to obtain.

say:10:1110432007:1.text: I may be greedy, but I'm also a coward! Every bottle I sold to those contestants contained only a tiny amount of the active ingredients, and it wouldn't last long.
say:10:1110432007:1.source_cn: 我是贪财，但更惜命！我卖给参赛者的每一瓶药水里，成分都...
say:10:1110432007:1.male: I may be greedy, but I'm also a coward! Every bottle I sold to those contestants contained only a tiny amount of the active ingredients, and it wouldn't last long.
say:10:1110432007:1.female: I may be greedy, but I'm also a coward! Every bottle I sold to those contestants contained only a tiny amount of the active ingredients, and it wouldn't last long.

say:11:1110432008:0.text: But the users of your potion reported strong results.
say:11:1110432008:0.source_cn: 可是用过你药的参赛者，都说药劲不小？

say:12:1110432009:0.text: Lady Mikola, haven't you heard? The will to fight a worthy opponent is more effective than any potion.
say:12:1110432009:0.source_cn: 曼卡拉大人，您还不知道吗？勇士面对强敌时，骨子里冒出的...

say:13:1110432010:1.text: That's true... So far, there haven't been any health complaints related to your product.
say:13:1110432010:1.source_cn: 唔……确实，至今为止，还没有用你的药后身体出问题的参赛者。

say:14:1110432011:1.text: So you're just in it for the money? Still, all swindlers must face consequences!
say:14:1110432011:1.source_cn: 你是想说，你只是谋财，没想害命？但为了谋财坑蒙拐骗，也...

say:15:1110432012:1.text: You're absolutely right. I would have never gone down this path if I didn't have a large family to feed...
say:15:1110432012:1.source_cn: 您说得太对了！可要不是为了养活一大家子，我也不会出此下策……

say:16:1110432013:1.text: It's tough to make ends meet in the desert. I have many children, and I can't let them go hungry...
say:16:1110432013:1.source_cn: 沙漠里，谁讨生活都一样辛苦。我家孩子多得很，我这个爸爸...

say:18:1110432014:1.text: Raising a bunch of Maulers is no easy feat...
say:18:1110432014:1.source_cn: 唉，养活小蛮血们确实不容易……

say:19:1110432015:0.text: Exactly! Speaking of which... I really need to get going. They're waiting for me to bring food home.
say:19:1110432015:0.source_cn: 可不是嘛！说到孩子想起来，我得回去了！不带口粮回去，他...

say:20:1110432016:1.text: See you later, Lady Mikola and everyone else. Thanks for forgiving me. I'll make sure to repay you!
say:20:1110432016:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，那我先走一步啦！曼卡拉大人，还有各位大人们，谢谢...

say:23:1110432017:1.text: Wait! Who said you could leave?
say:23:1110432017:1.source_cn: 等等！曼卡拉还没让你走呢！

say:25:1110432018:1.text: He's already gone... Gosh, he's fast!
say:25:1110432018:1.source_cn: 已经跑远了……比我滚得还快！

say:26:1110432019:1.text: Well, at least we got some new information. Our hard work wasn't for nothing. Let's head back to camp.
say:26:1110432019:1.source_cn: 好吧。也算了解了些内情，没有白忙一场。先回营地吧。

choice:7:0:1.text: Why do they cost so much?
choice:7:0:1.male: Why do they cost so much?
choice:7:0:1.female: Why do they cost so much?

say:0:1110433001:0.text: Right on time! Soren! Alsa! Meet your opponent, Seth of the Fara Clan.
say:0:1110433001:0.source_cn: 你们来得正好！索恩！阿尔萨！来见见你们的对手！这位是来...

say:1:1110434001:1.text: Welcome back to the Sunseek Arena, dear friends!
say:1:1110434001:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的老朋友们，欢迎回到残阳武斗场！

say:2:1110434002:1.text: Throughout the Warsong Festival, we've witnessed the blood, sweat, and determination of our Mauler fighters. Let's give all our contestants a warm round of applause for reaching this final challenge!
say:2:1110434002:1.source_cn: 战歌节开幕以来，我们一起见识了蛮血勇士们的鲜血、汗水与...

say:3:1110434003:1.text: Since we're short on time, let's get straight to it. The venue for the <style="highlight">Trial of Wisdom</style> is—
say:3:1110434003:1.source_cn: 时间有限，曼卡拉也不卖关子了！<style=highl...

say:4:1110434004:1.text: The Sandswirl Field! The token of this trial, the <style="highlight">Huntsman's Necklace</style>, will be placed at the end of the trial. The first one to retrieve it and hand it to me wins!
say:4:1110434004:1.source_cn: 迷沙试炼场！在试炼场的终点，放着本次试炼的信物<sty...

say:9:1110434006:1.text: Unfortunately for you, you're facing me in this challenge. I'm afraid you don't stand a chance!
say:9:1110434006:1.source_cn: 很可惜，对手是我，你们已经没有机会了。

say:12:1110434007:1.text: Both parties are ready to battle! But remember, this test is called the Trial of Wisdom. Don't forget to use your brains!
say:12:1110434007:1.source_cn: 看起来双方已经战意似火，不过曼卡拉提示你们，本次是智之...

say:13:1110434008:1.text: Put aside any conflicts and head to the Sandswirl Field!
say:13:1110434008:1.source_cn: 先把争端放在一边，一起朝着迷沙试炼场出发吧！

say:4:1110424001:0.text: Talk about like father, like son! Well done, congratulations! How does it feel to taste defeat this time around?
say:4:1110424001:0.source_cn: 真是虎父无犬子啊，可喜可贺！这败北的苦果，滋味如何？
say:4:1110424001:0.male: Talk about like father, like son! Well done, congratulations! How does it feel to taste defeat this time around?
say:4:1110424001:0.female: Talk about like father, like son! Well done, congratulations! How does it feel to taste defeat this time around?

say:5:1110424002:0.text: Must be even more bitter than ten years ago, getting bested by your own flesh and blood. Bet it stings more than being trounced by the likes of Brutus, huh?
say:5:1110424002:0.source_cn: 和十年前相比呢？现在更苦涩吧？被亲生儿子打败，听起来比...
say:5:1110424002:0.male: Must be even more bitter than ten years ago, getting bested by your own flesh and blood. Bet it stings more than being trounced by the likes of Brutus, huh?
say:5:1110424002:0.female: Must be even more bitter than ten years ago, getting bested by your own flesh and blood. Bet it stings more than being trounced by the likes of Brutus, huh?

say:7:1110424003:1.text: Merlin, is this how mages behave? Dropping in unannounced and spewing nonsense?
say:7:1110424003:1.source_cn: 梅林，这就是魔法师的礼貌吗？不请自来，又口吐狂言。
say:7:1110424003:1.male: Merlin, is this how mages behave? Dropping in unannounced and spewing nonsense?
say:7:1110424003:1.female: Merlin, is this how mages behave? Dropping in unannounced and spewing nonsense?

say:8:1110424004:0.text: Spare me your wrath, Orson. I'm here seeking a partnership, after all.
say:8:1110424004:0.source_cn: 奥格大人，气不要撒在我身上。毕竟，我可是来寻求合作的。
say:8:1110424004:0.male: Spare me your wrath, Orson. I'm here seeking a partnership, after all.
say:8:1110424004:0.female: Spare me your wrath, Orson. I'm here seeking a partnership, after all.

say:9:1110424005:1.text: I'm offering you an opportunity to defeat Brutus.
say:9:1110424005:1.source_cn: 在下只是来给你提供一个机会，能够打败布鲁特斯的机会。
say:9:1110424005:1.male: I'm offering you an opportunity to defeat Brutus.
say:9:1110424005:1.female: I'm offering you an opportunity to defeat Brutus.

say:11:1110424007:0.text: Nothing awfully complicated. And once we succeed, the gracious Dura will reward you handsomely.
say:11:1110424007:0.source_cn: 只是做一些小小的事情而已，成功后，慷慨的“艾雅”会予以奖赏。
say:11:1110424007:0.male: Nothing awfully complicated. And once we succeed, the gracious Dura will reward you handsomely.
say:11:1110424007:0.female: Nothing awfully complicated. And once we succeed, the gracious Dura will reward you handsomely.

say:12:1110424008:1.text: Hah, your goddess means nothing to me. Power is all that matters.
say:12:1110424008:1.source_cn: 哼，我对你们的女神没有兴趣，我只笃信力量。

say:13:1110424009:0.text: Even better, the alliance is sealed. Take these healing potions. You need to get back on your feet fast if our plan is to take off...
say:13:1110424009:0.source_cn: 那就更好了，联盟成立。请收下这些伤药。您要快快痊愈才行...
say:13:1110424009:0.male: Even better, the alliance is sealed. Take these healing potions. You need to get back on your feet fast if our plan is to take off...
say:13:1110424009:0.female: Even better, the alliance is sealed. Take these healing potions. You need to get back on your feet fast if our plan is to take off...

narration:15:11010104:0.text: While Orson is dressing his wound, the fake Merlin suddenly appears.
narration:15:11010104:0.source_cn: 奥格正在包扎伤口，“假梅林”却不知从哪冒了出来。
narration:15:11010104:0.male: While Orson is dressing his wound, the fake Merlin suddenly appears.
narration:15:11010104:0.female: While Orson is dressing his wound, the fake Merlin suddenly appears.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1110428002:.text: It wasn't easy to get this far!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1110428005:.text: A business opportunity has presented itself!
